$description: Live interaction shell. The stage art (portraits, meeting tiles, sponsor avatar) is always light art under a dark shade, so these keep one value in both modes, as the design draws them.

frustrated.$description: 1:1 mood ring and pill dot: frustrated

guarded.$description: 1:1 mood ring and pill dot: guarded

open.$description: 1:1 mood ring and pill dot: more open

speaking.$description: Active speaker ring and tag in the meeting grid

speaking-glow.$description: Halo around the active speaker tile

on-signal.$description: Text on the speaking tag, the raised hand, the header badge and the sponsor avatar

hand.$description: Raised hand button on a meeting tile

tile-shade.$description: Bottom of the meeting tile overlay, behind the name

sponsor-ring.$description: Pulse ring around the sponsor avatar while she speaks

chip-avatar.$description: Backdrop of a recipient chip avatar

listening-ring.$description: Ring around the reply bar while the mic listens
